name: CMHC Housing Starts, Completions and Units Under Construction Tables
update_frequency: Monthly and quarterly, depending on table
known_limitations: The tables help distinguish starts, completions, and units under construction, but interpretation still requires local municipal records, project-finance context, servicing capacity, absorption data, and definitions matched to the specific geography being analyzed.
notes: Official CMHC housing market data page with tables for pending starts, housing starts, completions, and units under construction by geography and dwelling type. Phase 35 check confirmed the starts/completions/under-construction tables and building-permit-to-start duration link.
